mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app.account_guard WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT recovery_state FROM app.account_guard WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE app.account_guard SET recovery_state = 'ISOLATED', isolation_reason = 'SECURITY_LEDGER_MISMATCH', version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.security_change ( operation_id, target_user_id, actor_user_id, change_type, expected_security_version, before_login_name_version, after_security_version, after_credential_version, after_login_name_version, safe_summary ) VALUES ( #{operationId}, #{after.id}, #{context.userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{type}, #{before.securityVersion}, #{before.loginNameVersion}, #{after.securityVersion}, #{after.credentialVersion}, #{after.loginNameVersion}, '{}' )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.security_change WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND db_outcome = 'COMMITTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE app.security_change SET external_state = 'RESULT_SAVED', last_sync_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE operation_id = #{operationId}
